example:
import { EditorialListingToolbar } from "@godxjp/ui/layout";

<EditorialListingToolbar count="396 results" note="Prices are reference values." actions={<Select aria-label="Sort" value={sort} onValueChange={setSort} options={sorts} />} />
name: EditorialListingToolbar

props.description: Free start slot (after count and note).
props.name: start

props.description: Free end slot (in place of actions).
props.name: end

tagline: The row between a catalog's filters and its results (gh#1438): the result count (a polite live region) and a short note at the start, the sort / view controls at the end. Geometry: `--editorial-listing-toolbar-*`.
usage: DO keep the count text short; a phone theme may hide it (--editorial-listing-toolbar-count-display).
